products.title: 01 PRO AGE FINE
products.description: BONITTO® 01 PRO AGE FINE is an ultra-plastic gel of cross-linked hyaluronic acid designed for treating shallow wrinkles and moderate skin defects. It is specifically intended for correcting areas such as the glabella, wrinkles around the mouth and eyes, neck, hands, and tear troughs. The gel provides natural volumetric correction by enhancing tissue volume, achieving a refined and rejuvenated appearance.

productImage.alt: BONITTO® 01 PRO AGE FINE: wrinkle filler for smoothing fine lines around the eyes, mouth, and neck areas.

campaignImage.alt: A woman with light skin and hair pulled back gazes over her shoulder. She has striking turquoise eye makeup that extends beyond her eyes, contouring her brows and eyelids. Her expression is serene against a neutral background.

products.title: 02 LIPS PLUMP
products.description: BONITTO® 02 LIPS PLUMP is an ultra-smooth gel of cross-linked hyaluronic acid designed to increase the volume of soft tissues and correct medium to deep wrinkles. It is specifically formulated for contouring and volumizing the lips, as well as addressing soft tissue defects around the mouth, puppet lines, and drooping corners.

productImage.alt: BONITTO® 02 LIPS PLUMP: Ultra-smooth hyaluronic acid lip filler for lip volume and wrinkle correction

campaignImage.alt: A close-up of a woman with artistic makeup. She has bold eyebrows, a vertical black line on her nose, turquoise eyeshadow on one eye, and matching turquoise on her upper lip. Her hands gently touch her face, and she has a serene expression.

products.title: 03 AGE SOLUTION
products.description: BONITTO® 03 AGE SOLUTION is an ultra-smooth gel of cross-linked hyaluronic acid designed for restoring or increasing the volume of soft tissues and correcting deep wrinkles and skin grooves. It is also formulated for contouring the facial shape in areas such as bridge of the nose, chin, nasolabial folds, and puppet lines. The gel provides visible volumetric correction by enhancing tissue volume, achieving a more defined and rejuvenated appearance.

productImage.alt: BONITTO® 03 AGE SOLUTION: nose and chin filler for non-surgical chin augmentation and facial volume restoration.

campaignImage.alt: A woman with an elegant hairstyle has bold turquoise makeup, featuring a line from her forehead down her nose and dramatic eyeliner extending from her eyes. The background is a soft gray, emphasizing her serene expression.

products.title: 04 FACE SCULPT
products.description: BONITTO® 04 FACE SCULPT is a powerful, highly concentrated cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel specifically formulated to increase soft tissue volume and facial contours. It is designed to sculpt and define facial features, including the jaw line, chin and cheek areas.

productImage.alt: BONITTO® 04 FACE SCULPT: Powerful hyaluronic acid facial filler gel for sculpting contours & adding volume.

campaignImage.alt: Close-up of a person's face with one striking green diagonal stripe of makeup across the cheek, contrasting with the natural skin tone. The focus is on the eye and the artistic makeup application.

products.title: 05 VOLUME
products.description: BONITTO® 05 VOLUME is a gel of cross-linked, highly concentrated hyaluronic acid designed for restoring or increasing the volume of soft tissues and contouring the body surface. It is ideal for addressing extensive atrophies, irregularities resulting from liposuction treatments, and volumetric body treatments. This product is particularly effective for contouring areas such as the buttocks, calves, and hands. It provides visible volumetric correction through a significant increase in tissue volume, enhancing the treated area to the desired shape. The visibility and durability of the effect depend on the depth of application and the original condition of the skin.

productImage.alt: BONITTO® 05 VOLUME - cross-linked, highly concentrated hyaluronic acid filler

campaignImage.alt: BONITTO® 05 VOLUME - filler for flabby skin, body shaping, contouring, buttocks enlargement, calf shape correction

products.title: 01 LUSH BLOOM
products.description: BONITTO® 01 LUSH BLOOM 22 mg/ml is a biodegradable crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel resorbed over time, intended to be injected in the lip submucosa or superficial dermis to restore lost volume of the soft tissue. BDDE-crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel 22 mg/ml when injected in the lip submucosa or superficial dermis, adds temporarily volume to thinned soft tissues of the face.

products.title: 02 LOVER TOUCH
products.description: BONITTO® 02 LOVER TOUCH 24 mg/ml is a biodegradable crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel resorbed over time, intended to be injected in the mid to deep dermis to restore lost volume of the soft tissue. BDDE-crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel 24 mg/ml when injected in the mid to deep dermis, adds temporarily volume to thinned soft tissues of the face.

products.title: 03 LIFT UP
products.description: BONITTO® 03 LIFT UP 26 mg/ml is a biodegradable crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel resorbed over time, intended to be injected in deep dermis or subcutaneous tissue to restore lost volume of the soft tissue. BDDE-crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel 26 mg/ml when injected in deep dermis or subcutaneous tissue, adds temporarily volume to thinned soft tissues of the face.

products.title: 04 LEVEL MAX
products.description: BONITTO® 04 LEVEL MAX 28 mg/ml is a biodegradable crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel resorbed over time, intended to be injected in the subcutaneous tissue to restore lost volume of the soft tissue. BDDE-crosslinked hyaluronic acid hydrogel 28 mg/ml when injected in the subcutaneous tissue, adds temporarily volume to thinned soft tissues of the face.

productImage.alt: A box labeled "Bonitto 04 Level Max" stands upright next to a syringe filled with clear liquid. The packaging notes 28mg/ml cross-linked hyaluronic acid, and features teal and black colors with sleek, modern design.

products.title: DrinxHa
products.category: 1 HA Syringe of 1,5 ml - 1 Concentrate Syringe of 0,5 ml
products.description: The kit contains 1 syringe of Hyaluronic Acid and 1 syringe of Tranexamic Acid, Alpha-Arbutin and Glutathione. The combination offers a dual benefit, hyaluronic acid provides deep hydration and plumping, while Alpha-Arbutin, Glutathione, and Tranexamic acid deliver powerful brightening effects, pigmentation reduction, and antioxidant protection Ingredients like Alpha-Arbutin, Tranexamic Acid, and Glutathione help reduce hyperpigmentation. Alpha-Arbutin inhibits melanin production and is 10 times more effective than Beta-Arbutin. Tranexamic Acid reduces dark spots by blocking UV-induced pigmentation and tyrosinase activity. Glutathione protects skin from sun damage, dehydration, and aging by neutralizing free radicals and promoting collagen production.

productImage.alt: A green box labeled "Bonitto" contains two syringes standing upright next to it. The text "DRINxHA" is visible on the box.

technicalInfo.label: Main ingredients
technicalInfo.value: Sodium Hyaluronate, Alpha-arbutin, Glutathione, Tranexamic Acid

products.category: 1 HA Syringe of 1,5 ml - 1 Concentrate Syringe of 0,5 ml

Sonicated hyaluronic acid, with its low, medium, and high molecular weights, provides multiple benefits, including stimulation and increased elasticity. products.title: VitalHa
products.category: 1 HA Syringe of 1,5 ml - 1 Concentrate Syringe of 0,5 ml
products.description: The kit includes one syringe of hyaluronic acid and one syringe containing perfluorodecalin, panthenol, bisabolol, and glycogen. These components offer recovery and hydration benefits, aiding in the repair of post-procedure redness while providing soothing and calming effects. Sonicated hyaluronic acid delivers a smoothing and revitalizing action. Perfluorodecalin is notable for its capacity to dissolve up to 49% of its volume in oxygen, which boosts oxygen levels and supports faster wound healing. Bisabolol helps hydrate the skin and alleviate burning and itching, while panthenol provides significant moisture and soothes redness. This product is suitable for use immediately after treatment to address skin redness and deliver intense hydration.

products.title: Bonitto Celestè Forte PL
products.description: Bonitto Celestè Forte PL formula combines PLLA , CaHa, Collagen type III, and Dual HA to deliver a powerful multi-layered collagen-boosting effect. PLLA works as a biostimulator that gradually activates fibroblasts, encouraging long-term production of collagen for natural skin tightening and volume restoration. CaHa provides immediate structural support while also stimulating collagen and improving skin firmness and definition. Collagen type III supports early-stage skin repair. It is one of the first collagens produced during tissue healing, so it plays a role in skin regeneration and renewal. Dual HA delivers instant hydration and subtle plumping, improving skin smoothness and elasticity from the first treatment.

productImage.alt: A teal and white box labeled "BONITTO CELESTE FORTE PL" with a small vial next to it. The box indicates the product is for face and body and contains three 5 mL vials.

technicalInfo.label: Active ingredients
technicalInfo.value: PLLA (Poly-L-lactic Acid), CaHa (Calcium Hydroxyapatite), Collagen type III, and Dual Hyaluronic Acid (HA)

products.title: Bonitto Celestè PL
products.description: Bonitto Celestè PL is a ready-to-use liquid formulation combining Hyaluronic Acid and Polylactic Acid. It is designed to deeply hydrate the skin, restore lost volume, and stimulate cellular regeneration by activating fibroblasts. The formula delivers an immediate volumizing effect while helping to improve overall skin quality. This dual-action solution effectively addresses common skin concerns such as wrinkles and volume loss. In addition to smoothing and plumping, it supports and enhances the skin’s natural regenerative processes, promoting renewed cell activity and longer-term rejuvenation.

effects: Balance in formulation creates balance in appearance

products.title: Bonitto Celestè Ultra PN
products.description: Bonitto Celestè Ultra PN formula combines PLLA , CaHa, Collagen type III, Arginine, Hexapeptide-40, Sh-Polypeptide-76, and Dual HA to deliver a powerful multi-layered collagen-boosting effect. PLLA works as a biostimulator that gradually activates fibroblasts, encouraging long-term production of collagen for natural skin tightening and volume restoration. CaHa provides immediate structural support while also stimulating collagen and improving skin firmness and definition. Arginine helps improve skin circulation, boost collagen production, and support repair, resulting in firmer, healthier, and more radiant skin. Hexapeptide-40 helps boost collagen, improve skin texture, and support regeneration for smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin. sh-Polypeptide-76 supports skin regeneration, boosts collagen, and improves texture for firmer, smoother, and more radiant skin. Collagen type III supports early-stage skin repair. It is one of the first collagens produced during tissue healing, so it plays a role in skin regeneration and renewal. Dual HA delivers instant hydration and subtle plumping, improving skin smoothness and elasticity from the first treatment.
